transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

Lately, my mood has been completely all over the place. I've been feeling this intense, overflowing happiness and energy, but then I'll suddenly get extremely angry and irritated over the smallest things. It just feels like I'm constantly bouncing back and forth between these two extremes.
During these episodes of intense happiness or irritability, have you ever experienced any breaks from reality, such as hearing voices or seeing things that aren't there?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I definitely haven't heard any voices or seen things that aren't really there during these episodes.

Have you ever had a period of abnormally elevated or irritable mood that lasted for at least 7 days, or less if hospitalization was required, and was so severe that it caused significant impairment in your social or occupational functioning?

Yes, I actually had a period like that recently that lasted for about a month, where I felt abnormally high and easily irritated. During that time, my energy was overflowing and I barely slept, which definitely caused some disruptions in my daily life. However, it never got so severe that I needed to be hospitalized.
Have you also experienced periods of significantly depressed mood, where you felt sad, empty, or lost interest in activities you normally enjoy, lasting for at least two weeks?
Yes, I've definitely experienced periods like that where I felt deeply depressed, sad, and completely empty inside. In fact, I've been stuck in that low state continuously for about two months now.

During your periods of abnormally elevated or irritable mood, did you experience any episodes that lasted for less than 7 days but were still severe enough to cause significant impairment in your social or occupational functioning, or required hospitalization?

No, I haven't had short episodes like that. My high-energy and irritable moods usually lasted much longer, for about a month, rather than just a few days. I have never been hospitalized or experienced that specific type of short, severe disruption.

Can you tell me more about how your daily life and relationships were affected during those month-long periods of high energy and irritability, and whether you felt like you were able to function relatively normally despite your mood, or if it significantly impacted your ability to work, socialize, or engage in usual activities?
During those times, I'm not entirely sure how to measure the impact, but I was definitely doing way too much at once and couldn't seem to sit still. I was still able

Did you experience any significant difficulties in your relationships or daily responsibilities, such as problems at work, strained relationships with family and friends, or an inability to complete tasks, during those periods of high energy and irritability?

I'm not really sure or don't recall having any major problems at work or with my family during those times. I was just extremely busy and constantly starting multiple projects at once, so I didn't notice any big disruptions of that sort.

Can you think back to those periods of high energy and irritability and tell me if, despite feeling overwhelmed and busy, you were generally able to maintain your daily routines and responsibilities without significant distress or impairment, or if it felt like your life was becoming unmanageable?

Honestly, I was able to maintain my daily routines and keep up with work because my energy was just so high. It didn't feel unmanageable to me, though I was constantly on the move and starting multiple projects at once. I just felt this unstoppable drive to keep active.

Did you notice any changes in your relationships with others, such as friends or family members, during or after those periods of high energy and irritability, and if so, were they positive or negative?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I didn't really notice how my behavior affected my relationships with my friends or family during those times. I was just so caught up in my own high energy and keeping busy that I didn't pay much attention to how others were reacting.
